# Vendor review

Each vendor on the [subprocessor list](../policies/subprocessor-list.md) is reviewed yearly. Contacts: [vendor contacts](../references/vendor-contacts.md). Terms: [terms](../glossary/terms.md).

## Checklist
Security questionnaire, data location, incident history, contract renewal date.
